ledgerEntry.title: Ledger Entry
ledgerEntry.description: Daily sales, expenses, and net profit ledger record for an informal vendor

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vendor owner

totalSales.description: Gross cash/digital income taken in for the day

totalExpenses.description: Total operating and inventory expenses incurred

notes.description: Optional notes or item description of goods sold

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was saved

userProfile.title: User Profile & Jurisdiction
userProfile.description: Vendor operating jurisdiction, trading duration, and business profile for compliance guidance

country.description: Country where the vendor operates (e.g. United States, Mexico, Kenya, India)

tradingDuration.description: Approximate duration the vendor has been operating

languageCode.description: ISO 639-1 language code selected by the vendor

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code derived from jurisdiction

/ledgerEntries/{entryId}.description: Collection of daily financial logs scoped strictly to the authenticated owner

/users/{userId}.description: Vendor jurisdiction and operating tenure profile scoped to request.auth.uid == userId
